The Etihad Rail passenger train is officially running, and it completely changes the commute. If you are heading out of the city, here is what you need to know before you book:

⏱️ Travel Time: Dubai to Abu Dhabi in just 64 minutes.
🎒 Luggage: 2 free bags (1 carry-on, 1 personal item) included with your ticket.
📶 Amenities: Free Wi-Fi, charging ports, and onboard food and drinks available.
🚗 Getting There: The Dubai station offers free parking for drivers. If you’re taking public transport, there is a brand-new pedestrian bridge connecting the station directly to the Jumeirah Golf Estates Metro Station, plus RTA feeder bus access.

📍 Etihad Rail (Dubai Station)
💸 Fares start from AED 39

Experience the ride for yourself. Save this for your next trip and send it to your travel buddy 👇

Atlantis Aquaventure is quietly giving away a complimentary second day of access for anyone visiting the waterpark this month.

Here is exactly how to unlock it:

The Deal: Purchase a standard Waterpark Day Pass (or the Super Pass), and you automatically receive a 100% free second-day access voucher.

How to Claim: Skip the physical ticketing desk and book directly through the Atlantis website. Your free second-day redemption details will be sent immediately in your confirmation email.

The Deadline: Your free second visit can be used on any non-consecutive day, but it must be redeemed on or before September 30, 2026.

Save this post if you are planning a trip to Atlantis this month.

What started with feeding a few stray cats has turned into saving more than 3,000 lives 🐈💗

Meet Dina Taji, co-founder of @dubaistreetkitties , who has dedicated years of her life to rescuing, caring for and finding homes for Dubai’s most vulnerable cats.

We visited her sanctuary, home to around 650 cats, to hear her story and understand what really goes into giving these animals a second chance.

And if there’s one thing Dina wants more people to know, it’s that adoption is the biggest help they need right now.

Watch our interview, read the full story on pike.digital and, if you’ve been thinking about welcoming a little furry friend into your life, this might be your sign 💌

🐾 @dubaistreetkitties
reels.transcript: Sometimes instead of waiting for someone else to act, we might just be their only chance that will help them survive. My name is Dina Taji. You might know me from Dubai Street Kitty Sanctuary here in the UAE, where we care for about 650 cats, and so far I've rescued around 3,000 cats. When we saw the number of cats that were being dumped either by breeders or people going back to their home country, that's when my friend and I realize we need to create a sanctuary for them. Someone sent me a picture of a cat hanging on a highway fence, and it was hanging all the way at the top because it was absolutely freaked out because of the cars. And it was like around 6:00 in the morning. I saw that I jumped out of bed, immediately drove over there, just to find the cat still in the exact same position. It bit my hand so deep, but I was like, I'm not letting go. And I managed to get the cat to the vet. This is our number one thing. If you were to ask me right now, what is the one thing that you would need the most for your sanctuary, is getting these cats rehomed. This is the most important thing. People that see this issue and they want to adopt because they want to help, but they they're hesitant because they don't know what to do. Maybe they never had a pet before. That's why it's really great, instead of committing and actually going for an adoption process, you can do what's called fostering. That that really make you realize that love is not just a human need. It's a universal need. And all they want to do is just be loved, feel safe and cared for. Aw, it's okay. They all just want to be loved.

Imagine cycling down one of Dubai’s busiest highways with no cars around. Well, you can do exactly that on November 1, because Dubai Ride is back!

There are two routes to choose from:
✨ 4 km around Downtown Dubai, perfect for families and beginners.
✨ 12 km along Sheikh Zayed Road, with views of some of Dubai’s most famous landmarks.

Did we mention it’s completely free?
Just make sure to register in advance, bring your own bike and helmet, and collect your rider bib before the event.

Dubai has driverless taxis, and you can book one now! 💌

Around 100 Apollo Go self-driving cars are already making their way around Jumeirah and Umm Suqeim, with no driver behind the wheel.

Here’s what you need to know:
You can book a ride through the Apollo Go app or select the Autonomous option on Uber when it’s available for your route.

For now, the service only covers Jumeirah and Umm Suqeim, and Apollo Go has been offering promotional rides for just AED 5 through its app.

So, who’s brave enough to get into a taxi with no driver?

Special thanks to @ms.ekaterina_f for the footage!
